gate.proceed: Automatic placement with source product name readable at final size, outside-support changes zero, no target manual edits, ad composition meets brief; narrow workflow feasibility only
gate.stop: Alignment/size/blankness failure, unreadable product name, obvious patch, or target manual corrections needed: report failed/limited and stop this one-shot workflow

timing: Wall clock from first tool timestamp through final artifact verification includes preparation, coding, generation wait, transfer, repair, QA and report; stage durations separately recorded. Not a human operator benchmark.
manual_accounting: Count source registration separately from target coordinate/pixel edits, prompt revisions, generation retries, and code preparation. Existing source regions are reused, so fresh annotation labor is not measured.

source_registration.method: register reference and import two previously specified source regions; not a newly timed manual annotation

next_rule: Report result, gate and next step. No claim that label restoration validates new-view 3D structure or improves production speed versus a baseline.
